[P2] Clear stale password-fallback status when email changes

After a `no_credentials` response, the status says no passkey was found and to use a password. The new input branch hides the password field and restores the passkey path but leaves that message in place, so editing the email can leave the form contradicting the active controls. Clear or update the status when resetting the fallback state.

public/auth.js:119-122
